description: Compare local calendar dates in the supplied zone, not elapsed 24-hour periods. The same local day uses time; one through six local dates ahead uses weekday and time; seven or more (and earlier local dates) uses date. Formatting stays native to each platform. Values are hand-written.

vectors.name: seven dates at midnight uses date
exactly seven elapsed days uses date
spring DST within six local dates
spring DST seven dates in fewer than seven elapsed days
fall DST six dates in more than six elapsed days
